The repair is booked: the contractor phoned the tenant and she agreed to a visit on the morning of Monday 7 December. So I've marked the appointment as booked, confirmed it to her by email and added a note to the case. Nothing failed and nothing needs a manager.

Any invoice over £250, or from a company other than Oakfield Homes, goes to the landlord before we pay.
